name: Bloom & glow
oneLiner: Bright areas bleed soft light: a soft-knee threshold (0..1) picks the bright pixels, an emissive layer the game draws into adds glow to exactly the things it marks (spells, lanterns, crystals, coins, a selected button), a dual-filter blur chain at 1/2 to 1/16 resolution spreads it, and a tinted additive or screen composite lays it back. A short flash of bloom on big hits. HUD rectangles never glow and never get washed. Six passes on the I-08 WebGL pipeline; without WebGL, or with ?webgl=0, the game looks exactly as before.
fits: any browser game drawn on one 2D canvas, pixel or HD, any resolution and CSS scaling
night, dungeon, space and neon scenes (luminance bloom)
daylight and pixel games with white UI (emissive-only glow)
action RPG, platformer, shmup (projectiles, pickups, muzzle flashes)
turn-based and tactics battles (spell effects, finisher flash)
notFor: games already drawn with WebGL or a 3D engine (use the engine's own bloom)
scenes that are almost all near-white (snowfields): luminance bloom washes them; use source 'emissive'
HDR-accurate lighting: the I-08 buffers are 8-bit, so nothing is brighter than white

needs: I-08 webgl-post (GameDNA_Post) loaded first; the game's existing instance, or one the module creates
render() once per drawn frame on every draw path
optional: the game's step-counted clock in ms (flare fade; deterministic ?t=&freeze=1)
optional: HUD rects in canvas px (uiRects) or a uiMask canvas
optional: per-frame emissive drawing of what should glow, at on-screen positions
optional: big-hit events with a contact point in canvas px (flare)
provides: bloom passes on the I-08 chain (order 600-605): threshold + soft knee, dual-filter blur 1/2..1/16, tinted add/screen composite
emissive layer: emissive() context and glow(x, y, r, color) helper, cleared once per frame
flare(strength, {at}): short flash of bloom from a point, fading in game time
HUD protection: uiRects / uiMask (white = HUD, blue = glow hole) with a feathered edge
stats(): passes, emissive frames, flares, HUD rects, frame cost

assets: module/bloom-glow.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_Bloom) adding six passes to an I-08 GameDNA_Post instance (shared or its own), the emissive layer, the HUD mask and the flare
requires elements/webgl-post/module/webgl-post.js (I-08), shipped next to it in the combo

module.skin: optional: tint and glow() colours may be skin tokens (fx.hot) when skin-api.js is loaded; the module draws nothing on the game canvas
